status_at_write: Fixed before agreement-result calculation; source schemas, provenance and the first source row inspected only.
scope: Exploratory development-only analysis of existing out-of-fold predictions; not an independent test.

rule.retain: For a target and a development row, retain only if all five profile decisions are equal. Each decision is probability >= that row/profile/target already frozen training-selected threshold. The retained prediction is that common binary flag. Otherwise withhold.

primary_reporting: coverage overall and separately among true positives and true negatives
full-55 original decisions for exactly the same retained rows
secondary_reporting: Five shared outer-fold coverage and stable wrong counts, descriptively; no independent-fold inference.
checks: Both OOF row identity sets exactly equal split development_row_indices; no heldout CSV is opened.
Unique row identities, aligned outer folds and target labels.
All probabilities and thresholds finite and in [0,1]; recorded decisions match probability >= threshold.
Threshold fixed within each profile/target/outer fold.
Full profile matches v2 selected probabilities within 1e-12 and decisions/thresholds exactly.
All 100 profile/target/outer models use only development IDs excluding the entire evaluated outer fold; model feature count and threshold match.
Input source hashes unchanged before/after computation.
restrictions: No fitting, calibration, model selection, threshold search, tuning or network/ML libraries.
No heldout row data or labels opened or rescored; no final evaluator called.
No changes to primary models, frozen final-61 results, app, report or video.
No CIs, calibrated-uncertainty claim, clinical confidence claim, causal benefit claim or winning/novelty claim. Retained errors must be stated.
undefined_metric_policy: JSON null when the mathematical denominator is zero; no zero-divison substitution.
denominator_policy: Retained recall is TP/(TP+FN) among retained true positives, not whole-cohort sensitivity. Whole-cohort retained-true-positive yield is separately reported as TP/all-development-positive-count.
interpretation: Shared feature subsets and training partitions make profile agreement dependent. Low retained error may reflect withheld case mix. This is a post-development exploratory probe. All negative findings are retained.
